title: Offices Configuration
description: First-class Office entity. An Office is a government body that provides Services, grouped by government function via an Office Group. An Office belongs to exactly one Office Group, even when its Services span multiple Categories.

officeGroups.description: Office Groups: groupings of Offices by government function (who runs this)

offices.description: All Office records, each belonging to exactly one Office Group

id.description: Unique, URL-friendly Office identifier (referenced by services[].providedBy)

abbreviation.description: Short form of the Office name, e.g. "CTO" (absorbed from the retired officials.departments[], ADR-0003)

groupId.description: Slug of the parent Office Group (must match an officeGroups id). Exactly one.

link.description: Destination route for the Office card

additionalServices.description: Office-only service names rendered as plain, non-clickable cards on the Office page. NOT Service records (absent from search and Category grids); deduped against the Services this Office providedBy. A service graduates into services.json with providedBy once it has a detail page.

sources.description: Documents this Office's data was transcribed from, primary first (#243, ADR-0005) — e.g. the Citizen's Charter, plus the city's key-officials directory for a phone the charter omits. Rendered as the Data source card on the Office page.

officeDetail.description: Optional rich content for the Office's dedicated service-details page. Mirrors the canonical services.json `detail` block (#184), minus its `office` contact sub-block: the Office is its own contact source, so getOfficeDetailBySlug synthesises the contact card from the Office's top-level fields (single source of truth).

sourceRef.description: One document a record was transcribed from (#243, ADR-0005). Only `name` is required: the validator deliberately enforces nothing else about provenance (#237) — the Office page render, not validation, is what makes an unsourced verification claim unreachable.

name.description: Issuing authority and document, e.g. "Las Piñas City Civil Registry Citizen's Charter, 2024 edition". Names the city, never this site.

url.description: Link to the document, present only when the authority publishes it. Absent for a tarpaulin or a PDF handed over on request; its absence never makes a record unverified (#238). Never a contributor's own photo or scan.

published.description: Vintage of the source itself, e.g. '2022'. Kept separate from verifiedOn so a fresh check cannot present old data as current. Nothing computes from it — there is no stale threshold (#237).

verifiedOn.description: ISO date this record was checked against THIS source. Asserts transcription accuracy, not currency.

covers.description: Field names this source backs, e.g. ["phone"]. Omitted for the source backing the record generally. Stored for auditability, not rendered.
